Dialect-aware

THE ENTERPRISE PLATFORM

From hello to resolution

Design, deploy, and manage dialect-aware agents that handle calls, messages, and workflows across support, sales, onboarding, and collections. Integrated with your systems.

Enterprise-grade by design. Customer data stays within AethexAI’s secure environment, with controlled access, privacy safeguards, and protection built for regulated industries.

[Book a Demo](https://aethexai.com/book-demo)

[Visit the Enterprise page](https://aethexai.com/enterprise)

![Screenshot of the Aethex voice agent platform](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FKYszwuqz2Aehenrk94OX898.jpg?width=800&height=514)

Agent Studio

Design conversation flows, set guardrails, configure personas. Inbound and outbound. No code required.

![Screenshot of the Aethex voice agent platform](https://framerusercontent.com/images/OlfXEPntXkXStg5EKoHqxc0Zo.jpg?width=800&height=514)

Simulate

Test agents against real call scenarios before going live. Validate behavior, edge cases, and compliance rules in a safe environment.

![Screenshot of the Aethex voice agent platform](https://framerusercontent.com/images/iW9w56afwRut9kleG7xOhMeDVYA.png?width=1600&height=1028)

Workflow Engine

Agents that act. Kora's workflow engine reads and writes data, triggers actions, and closes the loops inside your existing systems, not alongside them.

Analytics

Know what's working and what isn't. Every call is transcribed, scored, and searchable with resolution rates, sentiment tracking, and agent performance available at a glance.
